issue.title: Bug: GCU Suite test_static_route passes erroneously namespace argument for multi-asic scenario

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Fixing the way `asic_namespacce` argument is passed to function `format_json_patch_for_multiasic`.
Function expects a list while argument is passed as value.,
As a result, function decodes as namespace the first character from the value, consulting to failure as the namesace is not found.

Failure is only for multi-asic platforms.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test case for multi-asic platform.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Namespace should be passed as a list.
`format_json_patch_for_multiasic(asic_namespaces=[asic_namespace])`

Right now is passed as value:
`format_json_patch_for_multiasic(asic_namespaces=asic_namespace)`
